{{Tocright}}

== Overview ==
A '''Treasure Chest''' is a special item you can uncover after finding a [[Treasure Map]] digging in various locations around the map. Equipping a map guides you to the exact spot where a hidden [[Treasure Chest]] is buried. 


[[File:Treasurechest.png|thumb|right|280px|''Opening a Treasure Chest'']]

== Obtainment ==
* After equipping a Treasure Map from your inventory, a colored arrow will appear on your screen directing you to where the Treasure Chest is located. 
* The arrow will turn vertical when you've reached the correct spot. 
* When you dig in the indicated place, text will appear on the screen that reads “You have found buried treasure!!”.
* A Treasure Chest will be added to your inventory. 


== How To ==
* To open a treasure chest, equip it from your inventory, then click the screen.
* The Treasure Chest will open and the items given will appear on the right side of the screen.


== Usage ==
[[File:Treasure_chests.png|none]]
* A Treasure Chest can grant different [[relics]] and ores with the '''Treasured''' modifier when opened. The loot depends on the location where the chest was obtained.

== Important Notes == 
* {{Stat|Size Boost}} applies to ores inside '''Treasure Chests''', similarly to geodes. However, ''unlike'' geodes, {{Stat|Luck}} does '''not''' apply to treasure chests.

* The '''Treasured''' modifier will be applied to all ores inside the chest. This is the only way to obtain the '''Treasured''' modifier.
